description: This file defines classes and methods for managing company information and overdue payment messages within an Odoo (OpenERP) module, including a res.company extension and a wizard for company setup.

classes.name: res_company
classes.description: Extension of the res.company model to include an overdue payment message field with default text.

classes.name: company_setup
classes.description: Wizard class for inserting and managing company information and overdue payment messages.

methods.name: get_message
methods.description: Constructs and returns a message string including the company's overdue message and phone number.

methods.name: onchange_company_id
methods.description: Updates partner and overdue message fields based on selected company.

methods.name: action_create
methods.description: Saves the wizard data to the res.company model and opens a new configuration window.

methods.name: action_cancel
methods.description: Closes the wizard without saving changes.
